name: STL Print-Ready Pipeline
tagline: Brief or STL in, print-ready file + specs out
blurb: Analyzes or fixes an STL, or designs new pieces matching a whole folder of reference STLs, then produces a validated, QA-approved print-ready file with specs, analysis, validation and renders.

params.label: Project name
params.placeholder: short slug used for file names, e.g. goblin-warband

params.label: Brief
params.placeholder: what the part is for, key constraints, how many pieces, style notes

params.label: Reference STL folder
params.placeholder: a single STL to analyze/fix, or a whole folder of STLs to match in style

task: Produce print-ready STL(s) for project {project_name}: {user_brief}. Printer bed: {printer_bed_mm} mm, material: {material}. reference_stl is {reference_stl} — if it is a single STL, consult the stl-mesh-analysis skill to analyze and fix it; if it is a folder of STLs, consult the same skill to extract a style profile (scale, proportions, base type, level of detail) and design new pieces that match it. If no STL reference exists, design from the brief and any reference_images ({reference_images}), marking measured fields UNKNOWN where they cannot be derived. Always write the analysis (or style analysis) report as stl_pipeline/reports/analysis_{project_name}.md regardless of which mode was used, so downstream steps and acceptance checks find it at the same path. Write the spec, analysis, validation and a QA feedback note that only states APPROVED once the design genuinely passes review, plus render preview PNGs. Follow stl_pipeline/ naming conventions exactly for every output file.
steps: Resolve reference_stl: single file, folder, or absent.
Single file -> run stl-mesh-analysis on it and write stl_pipeline/reports/analysis_{project_name}.md.
Folder -> run stl-mesh-analysis across the set (sampled at 25 max), extract the STYLE PROFILE, and write it to the same stl_pipeline/reports/analysis_{project_name}.md path.
Neither -> summarize reference_images/brief into the same report format, marking UNKNOWN fields.
Write stl_pipeline/specs/spec_{project_name}.md from the brief and the analysis/style profile.
Design or fix the model(s); export stl_pipeline/design/output/design_{project_name}_v1.stl.
Validate the model(s) against printer_bed_mm and material; write stl_pipeline/reports/validation_{project_name}.md.
QA review the finished design(s) against the style profile when one exists; write stl_pipeline/reports/qa_feedback_{project_name}.md and only write APPROVED once it genuinely passes.
